summary.name: Grunge
summary.visualIdentity: Explicit: worn surfaces with distressed ink, scratches, stains, incomplete lettering and rough substrates. Texture density and scale must keep the message clear. Wear appears through local erasures and surface reveals, not whole-frame darkening or persistent noise over the subject. Provenance is supplemental, not a directly named source style.
summary.suitableUses: Explicit: texture-led title sequences and mood pieces; listed pairings cite gritty brand statements, music promos and documentary chapter titles. Inferred: suits video and interactive headings where the worn surface stays primary. Unspecified: audience, topic, duration and aspect ratio are not supplied.
summary.limitations: Explicit: avoid darkening the whole frame, full-frame noise over text, glossy blur, exposed texture edges and bouncy easing. Motion-020 glitch cut suits this style but should be omitted for calm editorial scenes. Rough.js must not roughen precise grids, UI or existing assets. The source frame review lists no sources, so no source color evidence is verified.
summary.palette: Background is scene-dependent: the #E4DCCD swatch is illustrative, not a required canvas, so choose the background from subject, lighting and mood. Suggested direction: worn paper, charcoal and restrained oxidized red, with foreground #302E29 and accent #8C5140. Task-supplied exact colors override these. Gradients are disabled. Two-color checks give 9.957 for foreground on background and 4.58 for background-colored text on the accent; recheck composited text over textures.
summary.motionAndInteraction: Explicit: video timing comes from seekable composition time through a paused GSAP timeline, with one owner per animated property. Shared guidance favors coherent easing but preserves sharp cuts, impacts and reading holds. Optional motion references are motion-012 chapter handoff, motion-015 narrative steps and motion-020 glitch cut; choosing none is valid. Scroll-driven behaviors are interactive-only and must become composition-time states in video.
summary.audio: Explicit: no audio requirement or supplied audio is specified, so audio is optional. Guidance: propose music, voiceover, effects, ambience or silence from topic, audience and motion, without assigning a fixed genre, tempo or voice. Honor explicit user choices and keep speech intelligible. Inferred: silence can serve reading holds. Unspecified: topic, language and delivery preferences.
summary.assetRequirements: No uploaded assets are specified and none are mandatory; visuals derive from the brief. Production needs precomputed distressed masks, ink textures and paper grain, reused identically across renders. Fonts must be loaded locally; font choice is unspecified. Exact copy is unspecified. Any supplied source artwork must keep its approved colors and be inspected before use.
summary.combinations: Explicit: style-093 supplies kinetic typography, revealing distressed headline words one at a time through local erasure masks, with only the active word distressed. style-101 supplies background depth through three texture planes, with foreground motion no faster than about twice the background and overscanned edges. Grunge works alone for texture-led title sequences; add supporting styles only when paced type or depth is needed.
summary.productionApproach: Canvas 2D is the style renderer for textures and bitmaps; Rough.js is optional for seeded sketch contours only. GSAP is the motion engine owning transforms and timing. Python with Pillow prepares masks and textures. chroma.js optionally validates colors. HyperFrames is the default pipeline for composition, sync, validation and export; Remotion is fallback only when HyperFrames is unavailable or a verified limit exists.
